$comment: Everything the code needs in order to behave like your division, and nothing else.
Content, links and translations are not configuration: they live in the database and in locales/.
Copy this file to division.json and edit it. It is versioned on purpose: it is behaviour, not a secret.
$comment.code: Your division code as IVAO writes it, 2 or 3 upper case letters. Staff positions are matched as ^{code}-.
$comment.countryId: ISO country used to ask the IVAO API for your FIRs and airports.
$comment.name: Division name, one entry per language listed in locales.
$comment.domain: Public host of the division, used to build absolute links.
$comment.locales: Languages of the division. Every one of them needs a locales/{lang}/ directory.
$comment.defaultLocale: Fallback language. It must be one of locales.
$comment.timezone: IANA time zone, used to show local times next to UTC.
$comment.logoUrl: Where the mark of the division is served from, or leave it out for a division that has none. A file of your own under web/public/ is the simplest place; the hub only draws whatever this points at.
$comment.faviconUrl: The icon of a browser tab, or leave it out for the browser default. A different file from logoUrl on purpose: the mark on the bar is drawn for a dark blue ground, and a tab icon has to read on light and dark tab bars alike.
$comment.icaoPrefixes: Safety net for filters and validation; FIRs and airports themselves come from the IVAO API.
$comment.modules: One entry per module you want to say something about. enabled: false switches an optional module off
(the department modules and the editorial core are always on). baseDepartment is the department every
row of that module is always in the care of, whoever else collaborates on it: events are always the
Events department's. Leave a module out entirely to take the defaults.
$comment.departmentMailboxes: Optional. The shared inbox of a department, by department code: where the hub sends the
notifications addressed to a department as a whole, on top of the people who are staff of it.
A department with no entry is reached on its people alone; leave the key out entirely if your
$comment.superAdmins: Bootstrap only: read once, when no super administrator exists yet. After that the database is the truth.
$comment.positionGrants: Optional. Permissions your division gives to a position rather than to a person: a department
at one or more levels (Coordinator, Assistant, Advisor, Member). Whoever holds that position
holds the permission. scope is the department the permission is held on; leave it out for every
department. Each grant is applied once, at the first start that finds it; after that the permissions
screen is the truth, and a grant deleted there does not come back. A global permission is never given
this way. The grants below are the ones the tours module expects for its base department (FOD), and the
training module for its own (TD), where a trainer is a Member of the department.
$comment.firStaffScope: all = FIR teams work on every FIR (default). own = each FIR team only sees its own FIR.
$comment.atcData: Optional. Where the ATC sessions of the network are read from, so that the controllers a pilot contacted
can be proposed on a tour report. none (the default) = no archive: the list is 'not available' and the
pilot writes it alone. vipi = the read-only view v_share_atc_sessions of a vIPI installation, reached with
ConnectionStrings:AtcData in a file under secrets/ and a database user that can only SELECT on that view.
